newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Terra Mining recommends Canadian takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: Terra Mining recommends Canadian takeover bid.

text.p: Swedish mining company Terra Mining has recommended shareholders accept a takeover bid by Canadian William Resources Inc.
Posting a sharp fall in nine-month profits, Terra Mining said its board had appointed CIBC Wood Gundy to advise on the 162.50 crowns ($24.65) a share takeover bid, made Nov. 2.

"Based among other things on CIBC Wood Gundy's opinion, the board further recommends that Terra Mining's shareholders accept the bid under the condition that financing is guaranteed," the company said in its nine-month report.
The bid by William Resources, running from Nov.14 to Dec. 12, was conditional on the Canadian company acquiring 90 percent of all the shares in Terra Mining.
Terra Mining shares closed at 159 crowns on Friday.

The miner reported a sharp fall in its results after financial items for the nine months ending Sept. 30. It posted a loss of 6.8 million crowns ($1.03 million), compared with a profit of 13.8 million ($2.09 million).
